name: SXSW Showcase
artistApplication: Official showcasing artist application via sxsw.com — requires EPK, streaming links, live video, social proof. Curated by genre panels.
deadlineNote: Applications open Sep–Nov 2026 — deadline approx. 1 Nov 2026
whyItMatters: SXSW is the world's most-watched emerging-artist showcase. One strong SXSW slot puts Donn in front of US agents, labels, and international bookers simultaneously. Afro house is underrepresented there — that's a gap, not a barrier.
recommendedMove: Decide yes/no before 20 Nov 2026. If applying: build a strong social proof story (IG 1k+, SoundCloud plays, 1 track on Spotify). Use the EPK template, attach the Paradiso/ADE credits prominently. Budget: delegate pass ~$1,500 + flights. If not this cycle, track for 2028.

name: The Great Escape
artistApplication: Artist application via thegreatescape.net — new music focus, curated by UK industry panels. Separate track for international artists.
deadlineNote: Applications typically open Oct, close Dec 2026 — confirm exact date on site
whyItMatters: The Great Escape is the UK's #1 new-music conference. A slot here = UK press, UK booker introductions, and a foot in the door for UK festival season 2028. Also feeds directly into Glastonbury/Green Man programmer networks.
recommendedMove: Apply in December alongside Tier A festival pitches. Key is having 1 track on streaming + a documented live video. Lean into the 'NL-born Afro house' angle — UK programmers actively look for non-UK African diaspora acts. Budget modest (ferry or budget flight Brighton is cheap from Rotterdam).

name: Eurosonic Noorderslag (ESNS)
artistApplication: Delegate pass + artist pitch. Showcasing artists are curated by ESNS programmers — requires separate application. Delegate pass available independently for networking.
deadlineNote: Showcasing artist applications close ~Oct 2026 — delegate pass available until Jan
whyItMatters: ESNS is Europe's most important new-music conference. Every major NL and EU festival programmer attends. Even as a delegate (not a showcasing artist), one day of targeted meetings can open more doors than months of cold emails. Groningen is 2.5h from Rotterdam.
recommendedMove: Book delegate pass ASAP for Jan 2027 (not the showcasing artist slot — not enough profile yet). Pre-book 10–15 meetings via the ESNS networking app. Target: Afro/urban programmers from Lowlands, Into The Great Wide Open, Paléo, Dour. Bring printed EPK summary cards + a USB with the set recording.

name: Reeperbahn Festival Showcase
artistApplication: Artist application via reeperbahnfestival.com — strong on European emerging acts, genre-diverse. International acts welcome.
whyItMatters: Reeperbahn is Germany's top industry showcase — major label A&R, EU booking agents, and international press all attend. A Sep 2027 slot perfectly positions Donn coming off the summer festival run, with a full content library and real numbers to show.
recommendedMove: Apply March 2027 with summer stats in hand (gig log, streaming growth, crowd footage). By then the EPK will be battle-tested. This is also a strong target for the 'agency pitch' phase — agents attend Reeperbahn specifically looking for acts they can sign going into 2028.

name: MAMA Festival (Les Femmes s'en Mêlent)
artistApplication: Artist application via mama-event.com — French market focus but international artists actively sought for African/diaspora programming strand.
whyItMatters: MAMA is France's main industry market. Direct line to French festival bookers (Nuits Sonores, Solidays, We Love Green) and African diaspora music labels. France is the second-largest Afro house market in Europe after NL/BE — a MAMA slot opens the whole French touring circuit.
recommendedMove: Apply April 2027. By then Donn will have Afro Nation Portugal (June) on the CV — that alone justifies a MAMA application. Target the 'Afropéa' and 'Club' programming strands. Consider approaching a French booking agency contact as co-applicant.

name: Amsterdam Dance Event (ADE) Satellite Show
artistApplication: Approach ADE satellite venue promoters directly — not an official ADE showcase application. Target: Shelter, De School successor venues, Bret, OSCAM outdoor. Book as a hosted night 'ADE week'.
deadlineNote: ADE satellite bookings typically confirmed Apr–Jun for October
whyItMatters: ADE is the world's largest electronic music conference. A hosted night during ADE week puts Donn in front of international agents, bookers, and press who are all in Amsterdam simultaneously. This is the single best domestic showcase opportunity on the calendar — and it's in his home country.
recommendedMove: Aim to host Donn's own ADE night (not just play someone else's). Book the venue in June 2027. Format: 3-hour headliner set + 2 support acts (local Afro acts). Document everything — ADE night content drives year-end momentum into 2028 pitching season.

name: Primavera Sound Emerging Artists
artistApplication: Open call via primaverasound.com — 'Primavera a la Ciutat' community stages accept direct artist applications. Main stage is agent/label submitted only.
deadlineNote: Community stage applications open Dec 2026 – Jan 2027
whyItMatters: Primavera draws 220,000+ attendees across 5 days. Even a community stage slot generates significant press and social reach. Barcelona is also a routing hub — combine with Sonar (same week, adjacent city) for a Spain leg of the summer routing plan.
recommendedMove: Apply to the community stage in January 2027. Simultaneously research Sonar direct submission. This is a 'double dip' opportunity — 2 Barcelona shows in the same week = one flight cost, two credits. Strong for the EPK going into agency pitches.

name: Afronation Artist Pathway
artistApplication: Afro Nation does not have a public open-call showcase. Route: (1) approach Afro Nation talent team directly via email with EPK + mix, (2) get on a satellite side-party first (Afro Nation week promoters in Lagos/Accra/Amsterdam run pre/after parties), (3) leverage NL Afro house network for introductions.
deadlineNote: No fixed deadline — relationship-based. Start outreach Nov 2026
whyItMatters: Afro Nation is the world's #1 Afro house / Afrobeats festival. Playing Afro Nation Portugal is a career-defining credit. The audience is 35,000+ Afro diaspora music fans from 50+ countries. Bookers and labels from the US, UK, and West Africa all attend. One set here = global visibility.
recommendedMove: Start mapping Afro Nation-week side-party promoters in November 2026. Target: Rotterdam / Amsterdam promoters who run Afro Nation warm-up events. Get on 1 side-party in 2027 as a stepping stone to the main festival in 2028. Build the relationship now — Afro Nation books 12–18 months out for emerging acts.
source: Excel tracker — S-tier target, Phase 3 routing

name: Groningen Noorderzon (Performing Arts)
artistApplication: Artist submission via noorderzon.nl — performing arts festival with club/dance programming strand. NL-based artists prioritised.
whyItMatters: Noorderzon is a premium NL arts festival — high production values, strong press coverage, and Groningen audience includes ESNS programmer network (same city). A slot here builds the 'NL festival artist' part of the CV and creates quality content.
recommendedMove: Apply February 2027 alongside other NL spring targets. The application is relatively accessible compared to Lowlands or Pinkpop. Leverage the ESNS January meetings — if you met a Noorderzon programmer there, name-drop it in the application.
source: Excel tracker — NL home market lock-in

name: Dour Festival Emerging Stage
artistApplication: Artist application via dourfestival.be — La Loupiote stage (emerging/club) accepts direct applications. Afro/amapiano strand actively programmed.
whyItMatters: Dour is the top Belgian electronic/alternative festival with 180,000 attendees. It shares audience with Tomorrowland and Pukkelpop programmers — a Dour slot feeds directly into the Belgian circuit. BE is the closest international market to Rotterdam (1.5h drive).
recommendedMove: Apply January 2027. Dour actively programmes Afro house / amapiano on La Loupiote stage — Donn is a strong fit. Combine with other BE targets (Couleur Café, Antwerp Pride) for a Belgium routing weekend. First international routing opportunity after NL.
source: Excel tracker — BE market, Phase 2 pitches
